name: 37379 · Soddy Daisy, TN
findings: ZIP 37379 (Soddy Daisy) has 57 nonprofit organizations. 17 of them (30%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 14 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 37379 (Soddy Daisy) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
